data.one_liner: A Dart MQTT client supporting TCP, WebSocket, secure connections and all QoS levels.
data.what_it_does: It implements MQTT v3.1 and v3.1.1, handling connection, subscription, publishing and keep‑alive automatically. It works on Android, iOS, web, desktop and server platforms.
use_when: Building IoT or chat apps that need MQTT communication
Integrating with cloud MQTT brokers like Google IoT Core, AWS IoT, Azure IoT Hub
Creating Flutter apps that require real‑time messaging over MQTT
avoid_when: You only need HTTP or WebSocket APIs
Your project already uses a different MQTT client that better fits your architecture
strengths: Supports TCP, secure TCP, WebSocket and secure WebSocket
Handles all QoS levels and keep‑alive automatically
Batch and multi‑unsubscriptions, making it efficient for many topics
Cross‑platform support (Android, iOS, web, desktop, server)
weaknesses: No native support for MQTT v5 (requires separate package)
Requires platform permissions for network access on mobile
Documentation is concise but may need digging for advanced use
data.setup_notes: Add INTERNET and ACCESS_NETWORK_STATE permissions on Android; add NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription and NSBonjourServices on iOS. No build_runner needed.
